name: The Klinique Medical Clinic Public Company Limited
summary: The Klinique Medical Clinic Public Company Limited provides skin medical treatment services under the Klinique brand name in Thailand. Its services include face lift, acne, pimples, and acne scars, skin tightening, filler, fat dissolving injection, laser hair removal, skin treatment, skin injection, mesofront, mesotherapy, and rhinoplasty, as well as nose, eye, and facial surgery. The company also offers skin medical services and distribution of cosmetics and medical cosmetics, and surgery services. The Klinique Medical Clinic Public Company Limited was founded in 2009 and is based in Bangkok, Thailand.
